Experiments on six widely used BioNER datasets demonstrate that MITE consistently outperforms representative BERT-based and LLM-based baselines and exhibits strong cross-dataset generalization. Ablation and parameter analyses further verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed components.
articles.titleCn: 通过多编程语言指令微调和集成方法增强生物医学命名实体识别
articles.abstractCn: 指令微调已成为将大型语言模型（LLMs）应用于生物医学命名实体识别（BioNER）的常见范式。然而，现有的指令微调方法仍面临两大关键挑战。首先，传统的自然语言指令通常将BioNER标注序列化为扁平文本输出，为类型化实体提取提供了有限的约束。其次，高质量的生物医学标注有限，仅从单个序列化输出形式学习可能限制结构多样性并降低模型鲁棒性。尽管可以引入外部生物医学知识来缓解数据稀缺问题，但这通常需要耗费大量资源构建。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了MITE，一种用于BioNER的多编程语言指令微调和集成方法。MITE通过将指令和实体输出都表示为代码格式化的形式，将BioNER重新定义为结构到结构的生成任务。具体而言，每个训练实例被转换为多种编程语言格式，包括Python、C++和Java，同时保持相同的底层实体语义。这些特定于语言的表示提供了结构多样化的监督，而无需外部生物医学知识或额外标注。在推理阶段，MITE通过实体级别的投票策略聚合不同代码格式的预测，减少特定于语言的预测方差并提高鲁棒性。在六个广泛使用的BioNER数据集上的实验表明，MITE始终优于代表性的基于BERT和基于LLM的基线，并展现出强大的跨数据集泛化能力。消融和参数分析进一步验证了所提出组件的有效性和鲁棒性。

articles.title: Continual Graph Memory for Mathematical Research Agents
articles.abstract: Using frontier agent harnesses to tackle mathematical research problems has emerged as an effective means of advancing mathematics. However, solving frontier problems in mathematics may require a massive number of agents working in parallel for extended periods to construct proofs, thereby generating an enormous volume of intermediate proof results. Organizing these intermediate results throughout a long-horizon proof-search process and reusing knowledge gained from prior explorations remain major challenges. We present Ansatz, a mathematical research agent built around Continual Graph Memory, a graph-based, evolvable, cross-problem mathematical research memory system that explicitly organizes the entire proof search process and reuses information from exploration trajectories of previous problems. Specifically, we develop a unified graph memory that represents all intermediate exploration results, including facts, plans, and counterexamples, together with edges that explicitly represent the relationships among them; dependency-aware retrieval supplies precisely targeted local context; an evidence-sensitive curator updates the research frontier and distills lessons from prior attempts; and scoped recall surfaces earlier statements and negative findings for local re-proving rather than uncritical reuse. Experiments cover runs across all ten First Proof Second Batch problems, together with four component studies. Ansatz reports closure on all ten research tasks, demonstrating its ability to sustain and resume long-horizon mathematical search. Beyond these problems, Ansatz also produces solutions to the Jamison caterpillar conjecture and Erdős Problems 289, 348, and 488 without human intervention, and makes partial progress on several open problems, illustrating its strong ability to solve open mathematical research problems.
articles.titleCn: 数学研究智能体的持续图记忆
articles.abstractCn: 利用前沿代理工具解决数学研究问题已成为推动数学发展的一种有效方法。然而，解决数学前沿问题可能需要大量代理并行工作很长时间来构建证明，从而产生海量中间证明结果。在长周期证明搜索过程中组织这些中间结果，并重用先前探索中获得的知识，仍然是主要挑战。我们提出了Ansatz，一个基于持续图记忆的数学研究代理，该代理是围绕一个基于图的可进化、跨问题的数学研究记忆系统构建的，该系统明确组织整个证明搜索过程，并重用先前问题探索轨迹中的信息。具体而言，我们开发了一个统一的图记忆，它表示所有中间探索结果，包括事实、计划和反例，以及显式表示它们之间关系的边；依赖感知检索提供精确的局部上下文；证据敏感的策展人更新研究前沿，并从先前尝试中提炼经验教训；范围检索揭示早期陈述和负面发现，以便进行局部再证明，而不是不加批判地重用。实验涵盖了所有十个第一证明第二批次问题的运行，以及四个组件研究。Ansatz在所有十个研究任务中都报告了完成，展示了其持续和恢复长周期数学搜索的能力。除此之外，Ansatz还未经人工干预就解决了Jamison毛毛虫猜想以及Erdős问题289、348和488，并在多个开放问题上取得了部分进展，展示了其解决开放数学研究问题的强大能力。

articles.title: Output Language Confusion under Multilingual Prompt Contamination
articles.abstract: Standard factual benchmarks assume clean monolingual prompts and exact-match scoring, two assumptions that break simultaneously in real-world multilingual deployment, from retrieval-augmented generation pipelines returning mixed-language passages to users pasting multilingual web content. We introduce Multilingual Distractor Interference (MDI), a lightweight and fully replicable evaluation protocol requiring no new data or annotation, in which factual questions are preceded by a semantically irrelevant foreign-language sentence, and evaluate five instruction-tuned LLMs across TruthfulQA and TriviaQA under eight distractor conditions (40,000 evaluations). Our central finding is a metric confound: for Llama-3.1-8B under a Hindi distractor, 58% of responses switch to Devanagari script, yielding a raw hallucination proxy of 0.710, but manual review reveals that 120 of 148 script-switched responses that were correct under clean conditions remain semantically correct despite being written in the wrong script, reducing the adjusted semantic hallucination rate to 0.470. All other models respond through abstention escalation with no hallucination increase. A paragraph-length English distractor triggers near-universal abstention (0.806-0.998) across all models, consistent with reading-comprehension confusion, a failure mode with direct consequences for multilingual RAG pipelines. TruthfulQA multiple-choice accuracy is unaffected under all single-sentence conditions. These results show that exact-match hallucination rates in mixed-language settings should be decomposed into script-switching and semantic error components before drawing conclusions about model reliability.
articles.titleCn: 多语言提示污染下的输出语言混淆
articles.abstractCn: 标准事实基准测试假设干净的单语提示和精确匹配评分，这两个假设在真实世界的多语言部署中同时失效，从返回混合语言段落的检索增强生成管道到用户粘贴多语言网络内容。我们引入了多语言干扰（MDI），一种轻量级且完全可复制的评估协议，无需新数据或标注，其中事实性问题前会加上一个语义上无关的外语句子，并在TruthfulQA和TriviaQA下针对八个干扰条件（40,000次评估）评估了五个指令微调的大型语言模型。我们的核心发现是一种指标混淆：在印地语干扰下，Llama-3.1-8B的58%响应切换到天城文脚本，产生0.710的原始幻觉代理值，但人工审查显示，在干净条件下正确的148个脚本切换响应中，有120个虽然写在错误脚本中但语义正确，将调整后的语义幻觉率降至0.470。其他所有模型通过回避升级进行响应，幻觉率没有增加。一个段落长度的英语干扰会在所有模型中触发近乎普遍的回避（0.806-0.998），这与阅读理解混淆一致，这是一种对多语言检索增强生成管道有直接后果的失效模式。在所有单句条件下，TruthfulQA的选择题准确率不受影响。这些结果表明，在混合语言环境中，在得出模型可靠性结论之前，精确匹配幻觉率应分解为脚本切换和语义错误两个组成部分。

articles.title: Probe the Harness: Setup Checks for Stale-Data RL Comparisons in Language Models
articles.abstract: Methods for training language models on stale samples are judged by comparisons against importance-corrected baselines. We show that details of the experimental harness can reverse the observed ranking of methods, and we introduce PTH (Probe The Harness), a set of checks that makes the harness visible. Our case is a comparison between SAN, a behaviour-free method, and truncated importance sampling (TIS) on verl and in a single-GPU trainer, in which SAN first finished ahead in both stacks. Four details of the harness changed this comparison: the PPO ratio was taken against the learner's own recomputed probabilities, the data seed did not reach the TIS arm, the replay queue reused its first batch for 33 updates, and two loss normalisers differed from their description. In each case the logged quantity looked consistent with a working setup, while the quantity that defines the comparison went unchecked. With the harness checked, TIS matches SAN on verl, and in the trainer TIS learns steadily while SAN keeps a margin. We contribute the signature of each detail and its effect on the comparison, reference results for TIS and uncorrected GRPO under sampler lag, and the PTH checklist.
articles.titleCn: 探索连接器：语言模型中陈旧数据强化学习比较的设置检查
articles.abstractCn: 在陈旧样本上训练语言模型的方法通过与重要性校正基线进行比较进行评估。我们证明实验框架的细节可以逆转观察到的方法排名，并引入了PTH（探测框架），这是一套使框架可见的检查。我们的案例是比较行为无关方法SAN和截断重要性采样（TIS）在verl和单GPU训练器中的表现，其中SAN在两种情况下最初都领先。框架的四个细节改变了这种比较：PPO比率针对的是学习器自己重新计算的概率，数据种子没有到达TIS分支，重放队列在33次更新中重复使用其第一批次，以及两个损失归一化器与其描述不符。在每种情况下，记录的数量看起来与一个正常工作的设置一致，而定义比较的数量则未被检查。在检查框架后，TIS在verl上与SAN持平，并且在训练器中TIS稳定学习，而SAN保持优势。我们贡献了每个细节的签名及其对比较的影响，TIS和未校正GRPO的下采样滞后参考结果，以及PTH检查清单。

articles.title: Misinformation Without Triggers: From Factual Answers to Downstream Decisions
articles.abstract: Language models learn from web documents, some of them false, and false content can reach a model's answer to a factual question and the summaries and decisions that use it. Most data-poisoning studies add a trigger to the training data and activate it in the prompt. False documents can also change factual responses without any trigger, but we do not know whether the direct answer predicts the decision. In this work, we follow false content past the answer and find an \emph{audit gap} between what a direct probe reports and what the model then does, comparing false training with matched truthful controls in a controlled decision task, \emph{Guess the Capital}, where a fixed decoder turns factual answers into a scored card choice, and on a misleading claim from Facebook posts about the 2019--20 Australian bushfires. Across eight models at dose 1,000, direct injected-choice rates reach 95.8--100\%, while injected game choices increase by 1.7--14.4 percentage points over matched truthful training. The gap runs the other way too. Facts that pass the direct probe still push decisions toward the injected answer, and game accuracy drops further than those choices explain. Truthful correction brings the fact back but not the decisions built on it. We then look into the real-world bushfire case, models trained on the false posts say that people were arrested for arson even when they lose the inflated count, and in a count-by-wording factorial the misleading arrest wording produces arrest assertions even when the training count stays at 24. In simpler terms, \textbf{a correct factual answer does not guarantee a correct decision, and losing the injected number does not remove the misleading story}.
articles.titleCn: 无触发器的错误信息：从事实性答案到下游决策
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型从网络文档中学习，其中一些文档是虚假的，虚假内容可能通过回答事实性问题、使用该回答的摘要和决策等方式影响模型。大多数数据污染研究会在训练数据中添加触发器并在提示中激活它。虚假文档也可以在不使用任何触发器的情况下改变事实性回答，但我们不知道直接回答是否会影响决策。在这项工作中，我们追踪虚假内容对回答的影响，发现直接探测报告的内容与模型随后行为之间存在一个\emph{审计漏洞}，通过在受控决策任务\emph{猜首都}中比较虚假训练与匹配的真实控制，在该任务中，固定的解码器将事实性回答转换为得分卡选择，并在关于2019-20澳大利亚丛林火灾的Facebook帖子中的误导性声明上进行分析。在剂量为1,000的八种模型中，直接注入选择率达到95.8-100%，而注入的游戏选择比匹配的真实训练增加了1.7-14.4个百分点。这个漏洞也有另一面。通过直接探测的事实仍然会推动决策朝向注入的答案，而游戏准确率下降的幅度超过了这些选择可以解释的程度。真实性更正使事实得以恢复，但基于事实的决策并未恢复。然后我们研究了真实的丛林火灾案例，在虚假帖子训练的模型中，即使被夸大的计数减少，也会说有人因纵火被逮捕，并且在按词计数的因子分析中，误导性的逮捕措辞即使在训练计数保持在24的情况下也会产生逮捕断言。用更简单的话来说，\textbf{一个正确的事实性回答并不能保证一个正确的决策，失去注入的数字也不能消除误导性的故事}。

articles.title: Evaluating VQA in Vision Language Models using Cooperative Principles
articles.abstract: We evaluate the performance of Vision Language Models in Visual Question Answering (VQA) when questions violate Grice's maxims. To do this, we use VLMs to generate question modifiers that add non-essential, ambiguous or false information and show that in the presence of such violations, the VLMs that we evaluate (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Llava) show diminished performance. Further, we empirically show the difference between how humans reason pragmatically compared to VLMs, and the difference in VLM reasoning when it resolves violations that are human-induced compared to those that are AI-generated. Finally, we show that human cognitive effort (measured through time-on-task in an experiment) is lower for resolving VLM-induced violations, but VLMs themselves perform less accurately in such cases.
articles.titleCn: 使用合作原则评估视觉语言模型中的VQA
articles.abstractCn: 我们评估了在违反格莱斯合作原则的情况下，视觉语言模型在视觉问答（VQA）任务中的表现。为此，我们使用视觉语言模型生成添加非必要、模糊或错误信息的提问修饰语，并表明在这些违反情况下，我们评估的视觉语言模型（ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini和Llava）表现有所下降。此外，我们通过实证研究展示了人类在语用推理方面与视觉语言模型的差异，以及视觉语言模型在解决人类引入的违反情况与AI生成的违反情况时的推理差异。最后，我们表明，人类在解决视觉语言模型引入的违反情况时认知努力较低（通过实验中的任务耗时进行测量），但视觉语言模型在这些情况下本身的表现准确性较低。

articles.title: Evaluating LLM-as-a-Judge Beyond Score Alignment: A Psychometric Analysis of Residual Judging Difficulty
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used as automatic judges, with validity typically assessed via alignment with human scores. However, aggregate agreement fails to reveal whether humans and LLMs find the same evaluation cases difficult. In this paper, we study this problem in summarization evaluation from a psychometric perspective. We fit Many-Facet Rasch Models separately to human and LLM ratings to decompose scores into latent summary quality, rater severity, dimension severity, and rating-scale thresholds. Building on this decomposition, we define residual hardness as a model-adjusted measure of judging difficulty and compare whether human and LLM judges share the same hardness structure. Across 17 open-weight LLM judges on SummEval, we find that moderate alignment in latent summary quality does not imply alignment in residual hardness. Human and LLM judges differ in which summary--dimension units remain difficult, and this mismatch is strongly dimension-dependent. Consistency shows a pronounced LLM-hard shift, whereas coherence shows a human-hard shift. We further show that human-easy but LLM-hard cases are partially predictable from observable source--summary properties. These findings suggest that aggregate human alignment reflects only part of LLM-as-a-judge reliability, while psychometric residual diagnostics support more informative judge evaluation and more targeted human--LLM collaboration.
articles.titleCn: 超越分数一致性：对LLM作为评判者剩余评判难度的心理测量分析
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）被广泛用作自动评判工具，其有效性通常通过与人类评分的一致性来评估。然而，总体一致性并不能揭示人类和LLMs是否认为相同的评估案例具有相同的难度。在本文中，我们从心理测量学的角度研究这一问题，在摘要评估中进行探讨。我们将人类和LLMs的评分分别拟合Many-Facet Rasch模型，以将分数分解为潜在摘要质量、评分者严厉度、维度严厉度和评分量表阈值。基于这种分解，我们定义了残差难度作为模型调整的评判难度度量，并比较人类和LLMs评判者是否具有相同的难度结构。在SummEval上的17个开放权重LLMs评判者中，我们发现潜在摘要质量的适度一致性并不等同于残差难度的共识。人类和LLMs评判者在哪些摘要维度单元仍然具有难度方面存在差异，这种不匹配强烈依赖于维度。一致性显示出明显的LLM难度偏移，而一致性则显示出人类难度偏移。我们进一步表明，人类认为容易但LLM认为困难的案例可以从可观察的源摘要属性中部分预测。这些发现表明，总体人类一致性仅反映了LLM作为评判者可靠性的部分，而心理测量学残差诊断则支持更信息丰富的评判者评估和更具针对性的跨人类-LLM协作。

articles.title: Query-aware routing for Cross-lingual performance gains in Encoders
articles.abstract: Multilingual encoders can exhibit reduced retrieval effectiveness when queries and relevant documents differ in language, despite strong same-language performance. We investigate whether Finnish and Swedish cross-lingual retrieval can improve while preserving an encoder's existing same-language performance and document index. We combine a query-only low-rank adapter, trained against frozen document embeddings, with deterministic routing based on query and index languages. Cross-language queries use the adapter, while same-language queries use the original encoder. SampoTron, our fine-tuned low-rank (LoRA) adapter alongwith the Nemotron-3-Embed-1B model, improves average retrieval quality across six English, Finnish, and Swedish directions from 0.241 to 0.291 in normalized discounted cumulative gain (nDCG) at rank ten, a 20.9% relative gain on a sampled financial benchmark. All six cross-lingual directions improve, and routing preserves the original same-language performance, including two full-corpus Finnish evaluations. The approach enables selective cross-language specialization with reusable document embedding vectors.
articles.titleCn: 针对编码器中跨语言性能提升的查询感知路由
articles.abstractCn: 多语言编码器在查询和相关信息文档语言不同时，检索效果可能降低，尽管其在同语言场景下表现优异。我们研究了在保持编码器现有同语言性能和文档索引的同时，是否能够提升芬兰语和瑞典语跨语言检索效果。我们将一个仅针对查询的低秩适配器（训练时冻结文档嵌入）与基于查询和索引语言的确定性路由相结合：跨语言查询使用适配器，而同语言查询使用原始编码器。我们的SampoTron（经过微调的低秩适配器）与Nemotron-3-Embed-1B模型相结合，在六个英语、芬兰语和瑞典语方向上提升了平均检索质量，在第十名的归一化折损累积增益（nDCG）指标上从0.241提升至0.291，在抽样金融基准上实现了20.9%的相对增益。所有六个跨语言方向均有所改善，路由机制保留了原始的同语言性能，包括两个完整芬兰语语料库评估。该方法支持选择性跨语言专业化，并允许复用文档嵌入向量。

articles.title: ConvoDrift: A Multi-Turn Conversational Dataset for Modeling Stylistic Tone Evolution
articles.abstract: The evolution of linguistic style in conversations is an underexplored issue in NLP. Most style-control datasets focus on sentences or assume a static style throughout, missing the dynamic shifts that occur as user preferences change during interactions. We introduce ConvoDrift, a dataset designed to model progressive stylistic conversational tone drift under fixed semantic intent. It is built on 15,727 shared multi-turn conversational structures for adaptation and persona-conditioned alignment methods. It consists of six prompt-response pairs per conversation, each with the annotation of style drift and style direction labels. These pairs cover a range of communication genres. We further derive a complementary pairwise dataset by pairing semantically equivalent but stylistically distinct responses and annotating persona-conditioned preferences using five distinct style communication personas, enabling the controlled study of personalisation and pluralistic alignment in language tone. In addition to dataset construction, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation involving human validation, LLM-as-judge assessment, and automatic lexical and semantic evaluations. Across seven Likert criteria annotated by three human annotators, the average Krippendorff's alpha is 0.88, and our lexical and semantic analyses show that drift events induce lexical changes while preserving semantic similarity.
articles.comment: 13 pages, 14 figures, 7 tables, Accepted paper at the 13th Conference on Computational Linguistics and Speech Processing (ROCLING) 2026
articles.titleCn: ConvoDrift：一个用于建模风格语气演变的回合式对话数据集
articles.abstractCn: 对话中语言风格的演变是自然语言处理领域一个尚未充分探索的问题。大多数风格控制数据集专注于句子层面，或假设风格在整个过程中保持静态，忽略了用户偏好随交互动态变化时产生的风格转变。我们引入了ConvoDrift数据集，该数据集旨在模拟在固定语义意图下逐步发生的风格化对话语气漂移。它基于15,727个共享的多轮对话结构，用于适配和角色条件对齐方法。每个对话包含六组提示-响应对，每组都标注了风格漂移和风格方向标签。这些对涵盖了多种交流类型。我们进一步通过将语义等价但风格不同的响应配对，并使用五种不同的风格交流角色标注角色条件偏好，衍生出一个互补的成对数据集，从而能够对语言语气的个性化和多元化对齐进行受控研究。除了数据集构建，我们还进行了全面的评估，包括人工验证、以大型语言模型为裁判的评估以及自动词汇和语义评估。在由三位人工标注员标注的七个利克特标准中，平均Krippendorff's alpha系数为0.88，我们的词汇和语义分析表明，漂移事件会导致词汇变化，同时保持语义相似性。

articles.title: Adaptive Mutual Distillation for Balanced Multi-Task Post-Training of Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Multi-task post-training of large language models (LLMs) aims to improve performance across tasks with unequal amounts of training data. Existing methods focus primarily on balancing task contributions during single-model training. Different task-balancing strategies can produce models with complementary strengths, creating opportunities for mutual distillation. However, the usefulness of cross-model supervision can vary across tasks, transfer directions, and stages of training. We propose Adaptive Mutual Distillation (AMD), a collaborative post-training framework that jointly trains two models with different task-balancing strategies. AMD evaluates candidate adjustments to distillation weights through short training probes shared across tasks, then uses task-wise validation scores to select an adjustment for each task and transfer direction. Across six benchmarks and three LLM backbones, both AMD models achieve higher average benchmark scores than supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines trained with the same sampling strategies. They also outperform the task-balancing methods evaluated in our experiments. Merging the two trained models can further improve their average benchmark score while yielding a single model for inference. The merged models outperform multi-task SFT by an average of 2.91 points across the three backbones.
articles.titleCn: 自适应互蒸馏在大语言模型平衡多任务后训练中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 多任务大语言模型（LLM）的联合后训练旨在提升不同任务上训练数据不均衡时的性能。现有方法主要集中于在单模型训练过程中平衡任务贡献。不同的任务平衡策略可以产生互补优势的模型，从而为相互蒸馏提供机会。然而，跨模型监督在不同任务、迁移方向和训练阶段中的有效性可能存在差异。我们提出了自适应相互蒸馏（AMD），这是一个协作后训练框架，它联合训练两个采用不同任务平衡策略的模型。AMD通过跨任务共享的短训练探针评估候选蒸馏权重的调整，然后使用任务验证分数为每个任务和迁移方向选择调整方案。在六个基准测试和三种LLM主干网络上，AMD模型的平均基准分数均高于采用相同采样策略进行监督微调（SFT）的基线模型。它们也优于我们实验中评估的任务平衡方法。合并这两个训练模型可以进一步提升它们的平均基准分数，同时生成一个用于推理的单模型。合并后的模型在三种主干网络上的平均基准分数比多任务SFT高出2.91分。

articles.title: How Robust Is Multimodal Claim Verification to LLM Rewriting?
articles.abstract: LLMs are known to introduce stylistic changes into generated text, yet how these stylistic shifts affect model decisions on scientific tasks remains underexplored. In this paper, we focus on multimodal claim verification, where the goal is to determine whether a textual claim is grounded in a given piece of evidence. We apply two rewriting strategies: natural rewriting, which simulates how researchers routinely use LLMs to polish academic text, and controlled injection, which inserts a single LLM-associated word to isolate the effect of vocabulary choice. We evaluate 11 open-weight models spanning five VLM families and ranging from 2B to 38B parameters. We find that models are robust to these modifications: most show no significant drop in accuracy, and compared to prior work on review-score manipulation, verification appears far more stable. However, consistent probability shifts do occur. Hedging-oriented conditions produce significant shifts across nearly all models, while boosting conditions show a weaker effect and general polishing conditions (e.g., grammar correction, fluency improvement) have little effect.
articles.titleCn: 多模态声明验证对大型语言模型重写有多强？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成文本时会引入风格变化，但这些风格变化如何影响模型在科学任务上的决策仍待深入研究。本文聚焦于多模态主张验证任务，该任务的目标是判断一个文本主张是否基于给定的证据。我们应用了两种重写策略：自然重写，模拟研究人员日常使用LLMs润色学术文本的方式；以及受控注入，通过插入单个与LLM相关的词汇来隔离词汇选择的影响。我们评估了11个开源权重模型，这些模型涵盖五个视觉语言模型（VLM）家族，参数规模从2B到38B不等。我们发现模型对这些修改具有鲁棒性：大多数模型准确率没有显著下降，与先前关于评审分数操纵的研究相比，验证任务显得远为稳定。然而，确实存在一致的概率变化。倾向规避条件的重写会在几乎所有模型中产生显著变化，而倾向增强条件的重写效果较弱，而一般性润色条件（如语法纠正、流畅性提升）则几乎没有影响。

articles.title: To Explore The Strange New World Beyond Data Distribution: System Behavior, Causality Tax, and Non-causal Base Model
articles.abstract: We show that the causality of language models (LMs) may not be necessary nor optimal. This is the case when system behavior (denoted as $S$) is incorporated as a first-principle Bayesian feature. Here, $S$ refers to extra dominant factors beyond the data space, and they involve coupled effects. Despite being the de facto foundation of modern architecture, recent studies indicate persistent mismatches and contradictions with causality. These issues largely stem from system behavior rather than the data distribution. We therefore propose the SBD framework, which incorporates $S$ as an irreducible component of the evidence lower bound (ELBO). SBD theoretically reveals a counter-intuitive Causality Tax phenomenon, where causality emerges as a suboptimal approximation with an additional structural error, due to the obliviousness to $S$. To address the challenge of latent variable analysis, we validate the SBD-predicted impact of $S$ via implicit measurements, theoretical-bound-guided controls, and Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) evaluations. In particular, we construct Green Shell (GSH) to show the possibility of reducing Causality Tax. GSH is a non-causal variational family, and it replaces the sequential dependency chain of $S$ components with a divide-and-conquer partition. NTK spectra in the lazy-training regime confirm that GSH always achieves significantly tighter error bounds than causality, with $7dB+$ improvement in signal-to-noise ratio. In the relatively later stage of lazy-training, GSH further leads to superior generalization (up to $20\%$ richer multi-scale fitting capabilities). Taken together, SBD establishes system behavior as a complementary theoretical abstraction besides causality and distribution fitting, opening new research avenues such as designing and optimizing LM base models.
articles.titleCn: 探索数据分布之外奇异新世界：系统行为、因果税与非因果基础模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们证明语言模型（LM）的因果性既非必要也非最优。当系统行为（记作$S$）被纳入作为第一性原理贝叶斯特征时，这种情况就会发生。这里，$S$指的是数据空间之外的额外主导因素，它们涉及耦合效应。尽管现代架构的实际情况基础，最近的研究表明其与因果性存在持续的不匹配和矛盾。这些问题主要源于系统行为而非数据分布。因此，我们提出了SBD框架，将$S$作为证据下界（ELBO）的不可约组成部分。SBD理论上揭示了一种反直觉的因果性税现象，其中由于对$S$的无知，因果性表现为次优近似，并带有额外的结构性误差。为应对潜变量分析的挑战，我们通过隐式测量、理论边界引导控制和神经切线核（NTK）评估验证了SBD预测的$S$影响。特别地，我们构建了绿壳（GSH）来展示减少因果性税的可能性。GSH是一种非因果变分家族，它用分而治之的划分替换了$S$组件的顺序依赖链。在惰性训练状态下的NTK谱证实，GSH始终比因果性实现显著更紧的误差界限，信噪比提升达$7dB+$。在相对较晚的惰性训练阶段，GSH进一步带来了优越的泛化能力（多达$20\%$更丰富的多尺度拟合能力）。总而言之，SBD将系统行为确立为因果性和分布拟合之外的补充性理论抽象，为设计优化LM基础模型等新研究开辟了道路。

articles.title: Clinical Concept Centers in LLMs
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in clinical settings. However, research into the reliability and performance of these models has focused almost entirely on the language substrate, scoring what the model says. Mechanistic interpretability has found that the latent space carries a higher fidelity of representation than the text: internal representations not only encode substantially more than the output verbalizes, but the stated reasoning also systematically omits features that causally drive the answer. An evaluation of model behavior in terms of mechanistic interpretability has not been explored in clinical decision support. In this work, we extend behavioral evaluation into the latent space and ask whether clinical concepts exist as locatable, causally used representations inside open-weight LLMs. We find dedicated clinical concept centers in the latent space of all eleven open models we test. These concept centers are interpretable, firing only on their aligned clinical narratives, and meaningfully and causally drive model behavior in both constrained and open-ended settings. They are not just analytical representations, but circuits that can be utilized in clinical practice, and we explore their use from the perspective of both evaluation and performance. From the evaluation standpoint, models stay internally coherent and keep using the relevant concept centers even under adversarial role-based priming, while aligned priming improves downstream clinical performance. From a performance perspective, we simulate realistic deployment settings and find that steering models along these centers leads to meaningful downstream improvements. Finally, we conduct a blinded clinician validation and find the activation and usage of these concept centers predicts clinicians preferences.
articles.titleCn: LLMs中的临床概念中心
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在临床环境中的使用日益增多。然而，针对这些模型可靠性和性能的研究几乎完全集中在语言层面，评估模型输出的内容。机制可解释性研究表明，潜在空间比文本承载了更高保真度的表示：内部表示不仅编码了远超输出所表达的更多内容，而且所陈述的推理也系统地遗漏了导致答案的因果关系特征。在临床决策支持方面，基于机制可解释性对模型行为的评估尚未得到探索。在这项工作中，我们将行为评估扩展到潜在空间，并探究临床概念是否作为可定位、因果使用的表示存在于开放权重的大型语言模型中。我们发现，在测试的十一个开放模型中，所有模型的潜在空间都存在专门的临床概念中心。这些概念中心是可解释的，仅在与其对齐的临床叙述上被激活，并在受限和开放式环境中有意义且因果地驱动模型行为。它们不仅是分析性表示，更是可在临床实践中利用的电路，我们从评估和性能的角度探索了它们的应用。从评估角度来看，模型在对抗性角色引导下仍保持内部一致性，并持续使用相关概念中心，而与之对齐的引导则提升了下游临床性能。从性能角度来看，我们模拟了真实的部署环境，发现引导模型沿着这些中心运行可带来有意义的下游改进。最后，我们进行了盲法临床医生验证，发现这些概念中心的激活和使用预测了临床医生的选择偏好。

articles.title: FSPO: Policy-Consistent Risk and Pareto-Feasible Control for Budgeted LLM RL Post-Training
articles.abstract: Adaptive LLM reinforcement-learning post-training changes multiple training actuators online, including rollout temperature, group size, clipping, KL regularization, verifier allocation, and update budget. Three coupled issues remain unresolved. A future-risk model trained from behavior trajectories need not estimate the risk induced by the controller that will be deployed; a score calibrated on logged state-action pairs can become miscalibrated after selective action choice; and independent per-resource minimum costs do not in general certify a feasible multi-resource continuation. We introduce FSPO, a feedback-state controller for budgeted LLM RL post-training that addresses these issues jointly. FSPO learns a policy-consistent risk-to-go model whose Bellman target follows the same frozen controller used for future decisions, together with a long-horizon utility model. Decision-conditioned trajectory calibration (DCTC) calibrates risk on cross-fitted trajectories generated by actions selected by provisional controllers. A Pareto resource continuation certificate (PRCC) admits an action only when a non-dominated cumulative reservation remains feasible over the residual horizon. Under a matched GRPO resource envelope, FSPO reaches 66.11% held-out and 59.43% OOD accuracy, compared with 64.47% and 57.03% for PB2, the strongest evaluated adaptive baseline. Three paired training seeds give gains of +2.42 and +3.19 percentage points over the contextual bandit on held-out and OOD evaluation. Under high behavior-deployment mismatch, policy-consistent risk lowers selected-decision ECE from 0.108 to 0.053; DCTC lowers it from 0.039 to 0.022 at matched acceptance; PRCC removes false-feasible admissions on an 18-action catalog ($0.197\rightarrow0.000$); and enabling all three components reduces trajectory failure from 0.181 to 0.083 in a factorial ablation.
articles.titleCn: 预算内LLM强化学习微调后的策略一致风险与帕累托可行控制
articles.abstractCn: 自适应LLM强化学习后训练技术会在线改变多个训练执行器，包括展开温度、分组大小、裁剪、KL正则化、验证器分配和更新预算。仍有三个耦合问题未解决。从行为轨迹训练的未来风险模型无需估计将要部署的控制器所引发的风险；在记录的状态-动作对上校准的分数在选择动作后可能变得误校准；独立每资源的最低成本通常不能证明可行的多资源延续。我们引入FSPO，这是一种用于预算LLM强化学习后训练的反馈状态控制器，可联合解决这些问题。FSPO学习一个策略一致的风险-剩余模型，其贝尔曼目标遵循用于未来决策的相同冻结控制器，以及一个长期效用模型。决策条件轨迹校准（DCTC）在校准风险时使用由临时控制器选择动作生成的交叉拟合轨迹。帕累托资源延续证书（PRCC）仅当在剩余范围内非支配累积保留仍然可行时才接受动作。在匹配的GRPO资源包络下，FSPO达到66.11%的保留准确率和59.43%的OOD准确率，而最强的评估自适应基线PB2分别为64.47%和57.03%。三个配对的训练种子在保留和OOD评估上比上下文 bandit 分别提高了+2.42和+3.19个百分点。在高行为部署不匹配情况下，策略一致风险将选定决策的ECE从0.108降低到0.053；DCTC在匹配接受时将其从0.039降低到0.022；PRCC消除了18动作目录上的误可行录取（0.197→0.000）；启用所有三个组件在析因消融中将轨迹失败率从0.181降低到0.083。

articles.title: Text-Centric Post-Training for Omni-Modal Reasoning
articles.abstract: Improving joint audio-visual reasoning in Omni Large Language Models typically incurs substantial data construction and training costs. Our diagnostics reveal multi-hop reasoning difficulties despite correct answers to all corresponding single-hop questions and suggest partial decoupling in the local optimization of perception and reasoning objectives. This motivates post-training with different emphases on these capabilities. Text-only reasoning training yields gains across data sources, model scales, and families. With the best-performing text-only configuration, supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning (RL) raises Qwen2.5-Omni-7B's geometric mean of nine reasoning scores by 25.83% over the base model, outperforming the complete native audio-visual route with 56.6% fewer GPU-hours. Training on data synthesized entirely by a text-only LLM raises this geometric mean by 21.01% without audio-visual data in construction or training. However, text-only training degrades perception. We therefore propose a text-centric post-training paradigm: text-only training provides the main reasoning optimization, and reduced-data native audio-visual RL then refines perception. Refinement uses about 90% fewer input tokens than full-data audio-visual RL, restores perception above the base level, and retains 93.5% of the best-performing text-only pipeline's reasoning gain.
articles.titleCn: 以文本为中心的跨模态推理后训练
articles.abstractCn: 改进全息大型语言模型的联合音视频推理通常需要大量数据构建和训练成本。我们的诊断揭示，尽管所有对应单跳问题的答案都正确，但仍然存在多跳推理困难，并表明感知和推理目标的局部优化存在部分解耦。这促使我们在这些能力上采用不同的重点进行后训练。仅文本推理训练在数据源、模型规模和系列上均取得收益。使用表现最佳的仅文本配置，经过监督微调后进行强化学习（RL），将Qwen2.5-Omni-7B的九项推理分数的几何平均值比基础模型提高了25.83%，优于完整原生音视频路径，且GPU小时数减少了56.6%。在完全由仅文本LLM合成数据上进行训练，几何平均值提高了21.01%，构建或训练过程中无需音视频数据。然而，仅文本训练会降低感知能力。因此，我们提出了一种以文本为中心的后训练范式：仅文本训练提供主要的推理优化，然后通过减少数据的原生音视频RL来完善感知。完善过程比全数据音视频RL减少了约90%的输入标记，恢复了感知能力至基础水平以上，并保留了93.5%表现最佳的仅文本流程的推理收益。

articles.title: RMCW: A Deletion-Robust Watermark Based on Reed--Muller Codes for Language Models
articles.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) watermarking provides a lightweight mechanism for identifying text generated by a specific model, but its robustness remains fragile under post-processing attacks. Deletion attacks are particularly challenging because they shift token positions and break the alignment between observed tokens and their original watermark positions. We propose Reed--Muller Code Watermarking (RMCW), an LLM watermarking method based on Reed--Muller codes. In contrast to global codeword recovery, RMCW searches for surviving local algebraic structure, leveraging the Reed--Solomon consistency induced by affine-line restrictions of Reed--Muller codewords. During generation, RMCW injects a Reed--Muller structure into the sequence via a secret-keyed vocabulary partition. During detection, it maps the given text to keyed vocabulary bins and tests local subsequences for low-degree Reed--Solomon consistency using Berlekamp--Welch tests. Experiments on C4 and ELI5 datasets with OPT-1.3B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct show that RMCW preserves strong clean-text detectability and outperforms or matches the baseline methods under several deletion and rewriting attacks. Our code is available at https://github.com/BaichengDanny/RMCW.
articles.titleCn: 基于Reed-Muller码的语言模型删除鲁棒水印技术：RMCW
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）水印技术提供了一种轻量级机制来识别由特定模型生成的文本，但在后处理攻击下其鲁棒性仍然脆弱。删除攻击尤其具有挑战性，因为它们会改变标记位置并破坏观测到的标记与其原始水印位置之间的对齐。我们提出了基于Reed-Muller码的Reed--Muller码水印（RMCW），这是一种LLM水印方法。与全局码字恢复不同，RMCW搜索幸存的局部代数结构，利用Reed-Muller码的仿射线限制所诱导的Reed-Solomon一致性。在生成过程中，RMCW通过密钥化词汇分区将Reed-Muller结构注入序列。在检测过程中，它将给定文本映射到密钥化词汇桶，并使用Berlekamp--Welch测试检测局部子序列的低度Reed-Solomon一致性。在C4和ELI5数据集上使用OPT-1.3B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct进行的实验表明，RMCW保持了强大的清洁文本检测能力，并在几种删除和重写攻击下优于或匹配基线方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/BaichengDanny/RMCW获取。

articles.title: ROUTEAUDIT: Interaction-Aware Identification for Budgeted Multi-Verifier Routing
articles.abstract: Adaptive multi-verifier systems are commonly compared through endpoint quality-cost gaps, even when the verifier catalog, availability, accounting, information filtration, or scorer changes with the policy. We formulate verifier routing as a contract-conditioned identification problem. The contract records request support, verifier catalog, realized availability, resource accounting, online filtration, and post-trace scoring; a matched route contrast changes only the policy coordinate. ROUTEAUDIT adds three measurable objects to this contract. A contract lattice averages coordinate increments over every admissible bridge order and reports the resulting attribution together with its path sensitivity. A policy-independent response tape identifies paired sequential contrasts when adaptive policies reveal different observations. For incomplete matching, request-level bounds use whichever potential outcome remains observed and give a sharp finite-population interval. The protocol commits paid observations and ledger events before the oracle join and returns an attribution certificate for each comparison. On two held-out raw-tail caches, matched static SF+SA equals the cascade, assigning the apparent gains of 0.1797 and 0.1250 over full static to the verifier-set edge. On 1,319 held-out task requests, the learned and RLVR studies report quality 0.9522 and 0.9553 versus 0.9484 for matched static; the RLVR-static paired difference is +0.0068 with a request-paired interval $[0.0015,0.0122]$ and a training-seed-by-request hierarchical interval $[0.0006,0.0131]$. Controlled attribution recovery yields route mean absolute error 0.0011 and endpoint reconstruction error 0.0004. Factorial, bridge-order, and stochastic-provider studies evaluate the certificate interface; RLVR supplies a learned-policy stress test under the same identification contract.
articles.titleCn: ROUTEAUDIT：预算多验证器路由的交互感知识别
articles.abstractCn: 自适应多验证器系统通常通过端点质量成本差距进行比较，即使验证器目录、可用性、会计、信息过滤或评分器随着策略的变化而变化。我们将验证器路由制定为一个合同条件识别问题。合同记录请求支持、验证器目录、实际可用性、资源会计、在线过滤和事后跟踪评分；匹配路由对比仅改变策略坐标。ROUTEAUDIT向该合同添加了三个可测量对象。合同格平均每个允许桥接顺序的坐标增量，并报告由此产生的归因及其路径敏感性。策略无关响应带识别自适应策略揭示不同观察时的配对顺序对比。对于不完整匹配，请求级界限使用剩余的潜在结果，并提供一个精确的有限总体区间。协议在预言机加入之前提交支付观察和账本事件，并为每个比较返回一个归因证书。在两个保留的原始尾部缓存上，匹配静态SF+SA等于级联，将0.1797和0.1250的明显收益分配给验证器集边缘。在1,319个保留的任务请求中，学习和RLVR研究报告质量为0.9522和0.9553，与匹配静态的0.9484相比；RLVR-静态配对差异为+0.0068，请求配对区间为[0.0015,0.0122]，训练种子按请求分层区间为[0.0006,0.0131]。受控归因恢复产生路由平均绝对误差0.0011和端点重建误差0.0004。因子、桥接顺序和随机提供者研究评估证书界面；RLVR在相同的识别合同下提供学习策略压力测试。

articles.title: OPD Before RL: Warm-Starting Rubric-Based RL with On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: Many useful language-model tasks cannot be evaluated by exact outcome verification. Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) addresses this issue by scoring open-ended responses against explicit criteria. However, because the reward is assigned after the complete response, the training signal does not directly identify which individual decisions contributed to the final score. We propose a two-stage training framework that uses rubrics first as privileged teacher context for dense token-level supervision, then as rewards for further RL. In the first stage, rubric-privileged on-policy distillation (RP-OPD), a student without access to the rubric matches a rubric-aware teacher's next-token distributions at student-generated prefixes. In the second stage, RL directly optimizes the rubric reward and improves beyond the observed distillation plateau. We evaluate the framework on health and science tasks using open-weight models. Across HealthBench, ResearchQA, and RubricHub Science, we compare post-training methods and vary the amount of SFT or RP-OPD training before RL, finding that our two-stage framework achieves the highest scores among the methods evaluated. RP-OPD + RL shows limited signs of reward hacking on RubricHub Science, whereas the SFT + RL baseline increasingly receives high rewards for claims of rubric compliance without providing the required content. These findings support using rubrics to guide on-policy distillation before applying rubric-based RL.
articles.titleCn: 在RL之前进行OPD：使用策略蒸馏对基于标准的RL进行热启动
articles.abstractCn: 许多语言模型任务无法通过精确结果验证来评估。基于评分标准的强化学习（RL）通过根据明确标准对开放式响应进行评分来解决这一问题。然而，由于奖励是在完整响应完成后分配的，训练信号并不能直接识别哪些个体决策对最终得分有贡献。我们提出了一种两阶段训练框架，首先将评分标准用作特权教师上下文进行密集的token级监督，然后将其作为奖励用于进一步的强化学习。在第一阶段，评分标准特权在线策略蒸馏（RP-OPD），一个无法访问评分标准的学生在学生生成的前缀处匹配评分标准感知教师的下一个token分布。在第二阶段，强化学习直接优化评分标准奖励，并在观察到的蒸馏平台期之外进行改进。我们在健康和科学任务上使用开放权重模型评估该框架。在HealthBench、ResearchQA和RubricHub Science上，我们比较了训练后的方法，并改变了在强化学习之前进行监督微调（SFT）或RP-OPD训练的量，发现我们的两阶段框架在评估的方法中实现了最高分。RP-OPD + RL在RubricHub Science上显示出有限的奖励操纵迹象，而SFT + RL基线则越来越多地因声称符合评分标准而获得高奖励，而没有提供所需内容。这些发现支持在应用基于评分标准的强化学习之前，使用评分标准来指导在线策略蒸馏。

articles.title: Automatic Evaluation of Mental Health Stigma in Online Communication
articles.abstract: Mental health stigma has profoundly harmful impacts but its complexity makes it difficult to evaluate. Stigma may involve explicit derogation, but also subtler forms of blame, fear, paternalistic pity, social distancing, structural exclusion, and discrimination. We introduce a theory-grounded benchmark for automatic evaluation of mental health stigma in online communication, consisting of naturally occurring online news and social media text annotated with a fine-grained taxonomy of stigma across multiple mental health conditions. Our annotation framework comprises a binary stigma-detection task and a multi-level taxonomy covering (i) stigma mode, (ii) domain, and (iii) specific components of certain forms of stigma. We apply this framework to texts mentioning six mental health conditions and evaluate large language models alongside stigma-related classifiers for detecting sentiment, toxicity, and hate speech. Results show that mental health stigma is not well captured by models trained to detect these neighboring constructs, and that LLMs often overpredict stigma unless given explicit operational rules - mirroring the importance of decision rules in human annotation. We release the publicly available part of benchmark, annotations, prototypical exemplars of stigma and code at: https://github.com/jemimakang/mh_stigma.
articles.titleCn: 在线交流中心理健康污名的自动评估
articles.abstractCn: 心理健康污名化具有极其有害的影响，但其复杂性使得评估变得困难。污名化可能涉及明确的贬低，但也包括更微妙的责任追究、恐惧、家长式怜悯、社会疏远、结构性排斥和歧视等形式。我们引入了一种基于理论的基准，用于自动评估网络交流中的心理健康污名化，该基准由标注了多类心理健康状况下细粒度污名分类法的自然在线新闻和社交媒体文本组成。我们的标注框架包含一个二元污名检测任务和一个涵盖（i）污名模式、（ii）领域以及（iii) 某些污名形式特定组成部分的多级分类法。我们将该框架应用于提及六种心理健康状况的文本，并评估大型语言模型与污名相关分类器在检测情绪、毒性和仇恨言论方面的表现。结果表明，心理健康污名化并未被训练用于检测这些邻近结构的模型有效捕捉，且大型语言模型在没有明确操作规则的情况下常会过度预测污名——这反映了决策规则在人类标注中的重要性。我们已将基准的公开部分、标注、污名典型示例和代码发布在：https://github.com/jemimakang/mh_stigma。

articles.title: Improving Atomic-Fact Recall via Focused Views in Unstructured Knowledge Editing
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as general-purpose interfaces to factual knowledge, but their parameters do not automatically reflect information that changes after pretraining. Knowledge editing (KE) provides a targeted alternative to costly retraining by modifying selected knowledge and preserving unrelated knowledge and general capabilities. Conventional KE uses structured factual triples, whereas unstructured KE (UKE) uses free-form passages containing multiple facts. Nonetheless, existing UKE editors exhibit a failure mode known as context reliance: edited LLMs can often reproduce the editing passage but fail to reliably recall its individual facts without the original passage context. We identify context-induced difficulty underestimation under the standard passage-level editing objective: later facts receive increasingly rich ground-truth context and consequently incur lower initial losses, making them appear easier to learn. In response, we propose FOVEATED, a plug-and-play framework that constructs focused views of each sentence by randomly shifting the Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) positions assigned to the keys of its preceding context. The perturbation is applied during editing and removed afterward, leaving the model's native positional encoding unchanged at inference time. We instantiate FOVEATED for both direct-optimization and locate-then-edit editors. We theoretically analyze how FOVEATED counteracts context-induced difficulty underestimation and empirically demonstrate consistent improvements across five KE editors, two LLM backbones, and three benchmarks.
articles.comment: The first two authors contributed equally
articles.titleCn: 通过聚焦视图在非结构化知识编辑中提升原子事实召回
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正日益成为获取事实性知识的一般性接口，但它们的参数并不会自动反映预训练后发生变化的信息。知识编辑（KE）提供了一种针对特定知识修改的替代方案，以避免昂贵的重新训练，同时保留无关知识和通用能力。传统的KE使用结构化的事实三元组，而非结构化KE（UKE）则使用包含多个事实的自由文本段落。然而，现有的UKE编辑器表现出一种被称为上下文依赖的失效模式：编辑后的LLMs通常能够复现编辑段落，但在没有原始段落上下文的情况下，却无法可靠地回忆其中的单个事实。我们识别出在标准的段落级编辑目标下，上下文诱导的难度低估问题：后出现的事实会获得越来越丰富的真实上下文，从而导致初始损失降低，使其看起来更容易学习。为此，我们提出了FOVEATED，这是一个即插即用的框架，通过随机移动分配给其前上下文键的旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）位置，为每个句子构建专注的视图。这种扰动在编辑过程中应用，并在之后移除，使得模型在推理时的原生位置编码保持不变。我们为直接优化和定位后编辑的编辑器实例化了FOVEATED。我们理论上分析了FOVEATED如何对抗上下文诱导的难度低估，并通过实验在五种KE编辑器、两种LLM主干网络和三个基准测试中验证了其一致性的改进效果。

articles.title: AptMQL-Bench: From Text-to-SQL to Text-to-MQL via Access-Pattern Schema Design and Data-Preserving Migration
articles.abstract: Document databases such as MongoDB are core infrastructure for modern applications, and natural-language interfaces to them---text-to-MQL---would let non-experts query complex, semi-structured data without mastering the query language. Progress on this task depends on high-quality benchmarks, which are most practically obtained by converting an existing text-to-SQL benchmark to the document setting. Unfortunately, existing efforts rely on heuristics for mechanical conversion: the document schema mirrors the relational foreign-key graph, and each query mirrors its source SQL. As a result in our experiments, these approaches fail to migrate 6 of 21 BIRD databases outright, silently drop up to 25.9\% of rows on others, and yield schemas whose ground-truth queries run over an order of magnitude slower as the data scales. We instead propose a conversion pipeline, driven by coding agents with human-in-the-loop verification, that designs each document schema from expected access patterns and rewrites queries to be MongoDB-native. Applying it to BIRD, we build an access-pattern-based text-to-MQL benchmark (AptMQL-Bench). It includes 21 document-oriented databases, 3,186 natural-language requests, and their associated MQL queries---whose databases are migrated from SQLite without data loss and scale efficiently. The strongest model, Claude Opus 4.5, achieves only 57.38\% accuracy without external knowledge evidence and 70.34\% with it. This indicates that realistic text-to-MQL generation remains challenging.
articles.titleCn: AptMQL-Bench：从文本到SQL到文本到MQL，通过访问模式模式设计和数据保留迁移
articles.abstractCn: 文档数据库如MongoDB是现代应用的核心基础设施，而自然语言接口——文本到MQL——能让非专业人士查询复杂、半结构化数据，无需掌握查询语言。这项任务的进展依赖于高质量的基准测试，而最实用的获取方式是将现有的文本到SQL基准测试转换为文档环境。遗憾的是，现有工作依赖启发式方法进行机械转换：文档模式映射关系外键图，每个查询映射其源SQL。在我们的实验中，这些方法无法直接迁移21个BIRD数据库中的6个，在其他数据库中静默丢失高达25.9%的行，并且生成的模式在数据规模扩大时，其真实查询运行速度慢了一个数量级。我们提出了一种转换流水线，由编码代理驱动并有人工在线验证，根据预期访问模式设计每个文档模式，并将查询重写为MongoDB原生格式。将其应用于BIRD，我们构建了一个基于访问模式的文本到MQL基准测试（AptMQL-Bench），包含21个面向文档的数据库、3,186个自然语言请求及其关联的MQL查询——这些数据库从SQLite迁移而来且无数据丢失，并高效扩展。最强的模型Claude Opus 4.5，在无外部知识证据时仅达到57.38%的准确率，有证据时为70.34%。这表明，真实的文本到MQL生成仍然具有挑战性。

articles.title: When History Fails to Become Experience: Action Calibration in Language Agents
articles.abstract: Language agents should draw on prior attempts and environmental feedback to improve subsequent decisions within the same task. However, providing additional interaction history can sometimes reduce task success, suggesting that agents do not consistently use this information effectively. To investigate this limitation, we examine how agents use history. We find that history improves task completion overall, yet much of this benefit persists even when past actions are shuffled. Disrupting the correspondence between actions and observations causes only a modest decline in task success. We therefore hypothesize that agents do not reliably connect past actions with their outcomes when deciding how to proceed. To test this hypothesis, we explicitly label each returned observation as the outcome of the preceding action. This simple annotation improves task success and reduces next-action repetition without introducing new environmental information. Building on this insight, we introduce a learned calibrator that explicitly reassesses past actions and selectively records experience to guide subsequent decisions, improving task success beyond outcome labeling alone.
articles.titleCn: 当历史未能成为经验：语言代理中的行动校准
articles.abstractCn: 语言代理应借鉴先前尝试和环境反馈来改进同一任务中的后续决策。然而，提供额外的交互历史有时会降低任务成功率，这表明代理并未有效地持续利用这些信息。为研究这一局限性，我们考察了代理如何使用历史信息。我们发现，历史信息总体上提高了任务完成率，但即使将过去的行动打乱，其中大部分益处仍然存在。破坏行动与观察结果之间的对应关系仅导致任务成功率适度下降。因此，我们假设代理在决定如何进行下一步时，并未可靠地将过去的行动与其结果联系起来。为验证这一假设，我们明确将每个返回的观察结果标记为前一个行动的结果。这种简单的标注提高了任务成功率，并减少了下一步行动的重复，而未引入新的环境信息。基于这一见解，我们引入了一个学习型校准器，该校准器明确重新评估过去的行动，并选择性地记录经验以指导后续决策，从而在仅进行结果标注的基础上进一步提高了任务成功率。

articles.title: EpiWorld: Grounding LLM Policy Agents in Epidemiological World Models
articles.abstract: Epidemic intervention policies are textual artefacts that human decision-makers interpret, justify, and revise through natural language, making large language models a natural candidate for epidemic policy reasoning. A naive LLM, however, lacks the epidemic dynamics needed to project intervention consequences, the quantitative surveillance signals required to assess severity, and the institutional constraints that define admissible actions. We present EpiWorld, a closed-loop framework that grounds an LLM policy actor in a learned action-conditioned epidemiological world model and a tiered skill library of public-health protocols, surveillance tools, and adaptive lessons accumulated through after-action analysis. Given a candidate intervention, the world model predicts regional epidemic evolution and enables fast counterfactual rollouts that provide feedback for policy selection and refinement. Outcomes of simulated futures are distilled into reusable lessons while protocol constraints remain fixed, allowing the decision process to improve without sacrificing interpretability or controllability. We evaluate both the world model and the end-to-end framework on retrospective COVID-19 and Influenza datasets: the world model achieves the best out-of-distribution Peak-MAE among all forecasting baselines, and the closed-loop framework reduces cumulative hospitalisation by up to 59% across datasets and by an average of ~16% across six LLM backbones, outperforming reinforcement-learning and optimal-control policy baselines.
articles.comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 22 pages
articles.titleCn: EpiWorld：将LLM策略代理锚定在流行病学世界模型中
articles.abstractCn: 流行病干预政策是人类决策者通过自然语言进行解读、辩护和修订的文本产物，这使得大型语言模型成为流行病政策推理的理想选择。然而，传统的语言模型缺乏流行病动态知识来预测干预后果，缺少量化监测信号来评估严重程度，也缺乏界定可接受行动的制度约束。我们提出了EpiWorld，一个闭环框架，将语言模型政策行动者嵌入到学习到的行动条件流行病学世界模型和分层技能库中，该库包含公共卫生协议、监测工具以及通过事后分析积累的适应性经验。对于候选干预措施，世界模型可预测区域流行病演变，并支持快速反事实推演，为政策选择和优化提供反馈。模拟未来的结果被提炼为可复用的经验教训，而协议约束保持固定，使决策过程在无需牺牲可解释性或可控性的情况下得到改进。我们在回顾性的COVID-19和流感数据集上评估了世界模型和端到端框架：世界模型在所有预测基准中实现了最佳的分布外Peak-MAE，闭环框架在所有数据集上累计住院率降低了高达59%，在六个语言模型主干上平均降低了约16%，优于强化学习和最优控制政策基准。

articles.title: Beyond Correctness: Resolving Underspecification in Agentic Text-to-SQL
articles.abstract: Agentic Text-to-SQL systems can interact with users to clarify underspecified queries before generating SQL. However, a correct execution result does not necessarily imply that the agent has adequately resolved the underlying underspecification: the agent may silently make unverified assumptions that happen to match the intended answer. We show that this behavior is driven in part by premature clarification termination. Although forcing an agent to ask more questions improves execution accuracy, ambiguities are concentrated in earlier interactions, making brute-force questioning inefficient. More importantly, even when explicitly prompted to plan its clarification process, the agent frequently abandons questions that it has already identified as relevant. To address this failure mode, we introduce PlanPool, which externalizes the clarification plan as a mutable question pool. Every planned question must be explicitly asked or dropped before submission, while newly discovered ambiguities can be added during interaction. Across three benchmarks derived from BIRD-Interact and Spider, PlanPool consistently improves ambiguity coverage and reduces silent failures over unconstrained and prompt-based alternatives, while maintaining competitive execution accuracy. Our results highlight an important distinction in agentic reasoning: identifying missing information is not sufficient, and the agent must also reliably maintain and resolve it before committing to an answer.
articles.titleCn: 超越正确性：解决智能体文本到SQL的欠指定问题
articles.abstractCn: 能够与用户交互以澄清不明确的查询，然后再生成SQL的智能体系统，但正确执行的结果并不一定意味着智能体已经充分解决了潜在的不明确性：智能体可能会无声地做出未经验证的假设，而这些假设恰好与预期答案相符。我们证明这种行为部分是由过早终止澄清过程驱动的。尽管迫使智能体问更多问题可以提高执行准确性，但歧义集中在早期交互中，使得暴力提问效率低下。更重要的是，即使明确提示智能体规划其澄清过程，智能体也经常放弃它已经识别为相关的提问。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了PlanPool，它将澄清计划外部化为一个可变的问题池。每个计划的问题在提交前都必须明确地被提出或被放弃，而新发现的歧义可以在交互过程中被添加。在从BIRD-Interact和Spider衍生出的三个基准测试中，PlanPool始终在不约束和基于提示的替代方案上提高了歧义覆盖率并减少了无声失败，同时保持了具有竞争力的执行准确性。我们的结果表明了智能体推理中的一个重要区别：识别缺失信息是不够的，智能体必须在提交答案之前可靠地维护和解决它。

articles.title: TPBench: A Turning-Point Benchmark for Dialogue Compression
articles.abstract: A compressor can keep the facts of a dialogue and still drop the turn that changed them. A user corrects a price, reverses a choice, or adds a constraint. We call this failure turning-point eviction. One overall retention score hides it, because that score mixes what the user first wanted with what the user wants now. We introduce TPBench, which evaluates three complementary information targets at shared nominal retention budgets. P1 asks for the user's initial goal. P2 asks for the current value of a slot the user revised. P3 asks for both, in dialogues with a late annotated slot update. The current-value answers come from the human dialogue-state annotations of MultiWOZ and SGD. The initial-goal answer is the first sentence of the first user turn. Neither requires new crowdsourcing. The probe-specific evaluations rank compression methods differently. On the joint probe at a retained fraction of 0.30, every tested compressed method remains below full context with the main Llama reader. Deleting the turn that carries the update sharply lowers current-value accuracy, while deleting one matched irrelevant turn leaves it unchanged. A Mistral reader repeats the P2/P3 rankings and the joint-probe gap. Current-value recovery is tested on an additional corpus, LongMemEval-KU, and on Chinese RiSAWOZ: full context has the highest accuracy, and recency has the highest compressed-method mean in both evaluations.
articles.titleCn: TPBench：一个对话压缩的转折点基准
articles.abstractCn: 一个压缩器可以保留对话的事实，同时丢弃改变这些事实的回合。用户更正价格、撤销选择或添加约束。我们称这种失败为转折点驱逐。一个总体的保留分数会掩盖这一点，因为它混合了用户最初想要的内容和用户现在想要的内容。我们引入了TPBench，它评估三个互补信息目标在共享的名义保留预算下。P1要求用户提供初始目标。P2要求用户提供用户修订的槽的当前值。P3要求在带有后期标注槽更新的对话中提供两者。当前值答案来自MultiWOZ和SGD的人类对话状态标注。初始目标答案是第一个用户回合的第一句话。两者都不需要新的众包。针对探针的评估会以不同的方式对压缩方法进行排名。在保留分数为0.30的联合探针上，每个测试的压缩方法都低于完整上下文的主要Llama读取器。删除包含更新的回合会显著降低当前值准确率，而删除一个匹配的无关回合则不会改变它。Mistral读取器重复了P2/P3排名和联合探针差距。当前值恢复在附加语料库LongMemEval-KU和中文RiSAWOZ上进行了测试：完整上下文在两个评估中都具有最高准确率，而近期在压缩方法平均分中具有最高分。

articles.title: WakeKV: Reactive, Reversible KV Residency for Heads That Change Their Minds
articles.abstract: Most KV-cache compression methods classify attention heads once, either offline or during prefill, and keep this classification fixed throughout generation. Across three models (1.5B-8B) and three regimes (needle retrieval, long chain-of-thought, and multi-turn recall), we measure head behavior on four model-regime combinations and find that most heads change their reading behavior at least once during generation. We introduce WakeKV, a reactive residency policy that moves cooling heads to a recoverable CPU reservoir rather than freezing or permanently evicting their state. At matched memory or budget, WakeKV consistently improves miss rate over frozen classification and destructive eviction, evaluated across five model-regime combinations and over three cited baselines (SnapKV, uniform R-KV, and ReasonAlloc) across four eligible combinations. A FlexiCache/vLLM implementation on Mistral-7B confirms the benefit on real hardware, improving throughput while retaining LongBench quality.
articles.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on ML for Systems. 2 figures, 4 tables, appendix
articles.titleCn: WakeKV：可反应、可逆的键值驻留，用于改变主意的键值对
articles.abstractCn: 大多数KV缓存压缩方法在离线或预填充阶段仅对注意力头进行一次分类，并在生成过程中保持这种分类不变。在三个模型（1.5B-8B）和三种场景（针头检索、长链式思维和多次调用回忆）下，我们测量了四个模型-场景组合中头的行为，发现大多数头在生成过程中至少改变一次读取行为。我们引入了WakeKV，这是一种反应式驻留策略，将冷却头移至可恢复的CPU存储池，而不是冻结或永久移除其状态。在匹配的内存或预算下，WakeKV在五个模型-场景组合和四个符合条件的组合中，在三个引用基线（SnapKV、均匀R-KV和ReasonAlloc）上，始终优于冻结分类和破坏性移除，提升了缺失率。Mistral-7B上的FlexiCache/vLLM实现证实了其在真实硬件上的优势，提高了吞吐量同时保持了LongBench质量。

articles.title: Silent Dissent: LLM Agents That Yield to the Majority Still Represent Their Original Premise
articles.abstract: Multi-agent debate is increasingly used to reach consensus among LLM agents, yet agents often yield to a unanimous majority. When an agent changes its answer, has it changed its mind or only its statement? We study this with two-hop factual questions whose intermediate entity (the bridge, e.g. the country in "the capital of the country where the Sagrada Familia is located") is never stated by anyone. Scripted peers, in the role of Asch's confederates, unanimously assert a wrong answer taken from another fact with a different bridge. At the moment the agent answers, we read the bridge from its residual stream with the Jacobian lens (J-lens) and, for comparison, the logit lens. In pre-registered tests on held-out facts with four open-weight models, agents of Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.6-27B and Gemma-4-E4B-it that gave in still represented their original bridge in the pre-registered layers below the output (hit@100 above a control entity: 0.85, 0.22 and 0.24), where the logit lens rarely ranked it among the top 100 tokens (0.00-0.06). These agents also represented the bridge behind the peers' answer, beyond a mention baseline. A pre-registered addendum hid the agent's earlier answer or removed it: agents that gave in still represented their original bridge in all four models (0.43, 0.29, 0.37 and 0.25 with the answer hidden), including Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, which barely did so with its answer in view (0.03). The premise can thus be computed from the question alone while the agent states the majority's answer. Hiding the earlier answer also changed conformity: Qwen3.5-4B gave in on 89% of questions instead of 8%. In exploratory interventions, injecting the bridge's J-lens direction brought agents back to their original answer only in the two Qwen models. Stated consensus in multi-agent debate can thus overstate agreement. We also report the negative results of our pre-registered program.
articles.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary material in ancillary files
articles.titleCn: 沉默的异议：屈从多数的LLM代理仍然代表其原始前提
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体辩论越来越多地用于在大型语言模型智能体之间达成共识，但智能体往往屈从于一致多数。当一个智能体改变其答案时，它是改变了想法还是仅仅改变了陈述？我们通过研究两跳事实性问题来研究这个问题，其中中间实体（桥梁，例如“圣家堂所在国家的首都”，在该问题中从未被任何一方提及）。作为阿希实验中的同谋，编写的同伴一致断言一个来自具有不同桥梁的另一个事实的错误答案。在智能体回答的瞬间，我们使用雅可比透镜（J透镜）从其残差流中读取桥梁，并作为比较，使用逻辑透镜。在预先注册的测试中，使用四个开放权重模型对保留的事实进行测试，屈服的Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.6-27B和Gemma-4-E4B-it智能体仍然在输出以下的预先注册层中代表其原始桥梁（在控制实体以上的hit@100：0.85、0.22和0.24），而逻辑透镜很少将其排名在前100个词中（0.00-0.06）。这些智能体还在同伴答案背后的桥梁上有所表现，超越了提及基线。预先注册的补充隐藏了智能体之前的答案或将其移除：屈服的智能体在所有四个模型中（0.43、0.29、0.37和0.25，当答案被隐藏时）仍然代表其原始桥梁，包括Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，当其答案可见时几乎不这样做（0.03）。因此，前提可以仅从问题中计算出来，而智能体陈述多数答案。隐藏之前的答案也改变了从众行为：Qwen3.5-4B在89%的问题上屈服，而不是8%。在探索性干预中，注入桥梁的J透镜方向仅在两个Qwen模型中将智能体带回到其原始答案。因此，多智能体辩论中陈述的共识可能高估了同意程度。我们还报告了我们预先注册项目的负面结果。

articles.title: Learning from Evolving Errors: Adaptive Iterative Repair for On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) supplies dense token-level feedback on trajectories sampled from the student's own policy, a richer training signal than the outcome-level rewards of reinforcement learning. This feedback comes from a teacher conditioned on a full reference solution unavailable to the student. The reference solution specifies the target but not how to move from the student's current error toward it, creating a solution-conditioned shortcut risk. We introduce AIR-OPD, an adaptive iterative repair framework for on-policy distillation that provides error-to-repair supervision. Given a failed response, a guidance generator synthesizes repair guidance for the current error. The student samples an on-policy retry with this guidance. If the retry remains incorrect, the generator produces new repair guidance for the newly observed error. At each round, a fixed teacher receives the guidance as privileged context and supervises the student on an error-aligned region of its latest failed response. Outcome-aware stage weighting favors early repair stages and credits stages whose immediate retry passes verification. We train AIR-OPD on the DAPO-Math-17K dataset and evaluate on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, alongside out-of-distribution tests on MMLU-Pro and GPQA. We examine two guidance sources, self-guidance from the current student policy and external guidance from a larger model. For both Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, AIR-OPD attains the best mathematical-reasoning averages, improving over the strongest baseline by up to 3.6 points, while preserving base-model performance on the out-of-distribution benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 从演变的错误中学习：策略内蒸馏的自适应迭代修复
articles.abstractCn: 策略内自蒸馏（OPSD）为学生自身策略采样的轨迹提供密集的标记级反馈，这种训练信号比强化学习的结果级奖励更为丰富。这种反馈来自一个基于学生无法获取的完整参考解的条件化教师。参考解指定了目标但未说明如何从学生的当前误差向该目标移动，从而创建了一个解条件化的捷径风险。我们引入了AIR-OPD，这是一个用于策略内蒸馏的自适应迭代修复框架，提供误差到修复的监督。给定一个失败的响应，一个引导生成器合成针对当前误差的修复引导。学生使用此引导进行策略内重试。如果重试仍然错误，生成器为新观察到的误差产生新的修复引导。每一轮中，一个固定的教师将引导作为特权上下文接收，并在其最新失败的响应的错误对齐区域上监督学生。结果感知的阶段加权倾向于早期的修复阶段，并认可那些立即重试通过验证的阶段。我们在DAPO-Math-17K数据集上训练AIR-OPD，并在AIME24、AIME25和HMMT25上评估，同时在MMLU-Pro和GPQA上进行分布外测试。我们考察了两种引导来源：来自当前学生策略的自引导和来自更大模型的 外部引导。对于Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B，AIR-OPD获得了最佳数学推理平均分，比最强的基线提高了高达3.6分，同时在分布外基准上保持了基础模型的性能。

articles.title: Large language models exhibit unreliable updating of clinical judgment as patient evidence evolves
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for clinical reasoning, but whether they appropriately revise judgments as patient evidence evolves remains unclear. We evaluated longitudinal belief updating using matched intensive-care trajectories from electronic health records. Across diverse LLMs, conditioning on a preceding judgment more often increased than reduced prediction error when estimates changed, replicated for a second endpoint. Controlled interventions revealed two failure modes. First, with preceding assessment fixed, models responded more strongly to worsening than matched improving respiratory evidence; this asymmetry persisted after headroom normalization at moderate and strong evidence levels. Second, with current evidence fixed, increasing prior risk from 10% to 90% shifted estimates by 26.2 percentage points, demonstrating causal influence of prior model beliefs. Prompting did not restore reliable updating. Evidence-Validated Longitudinal Update (EVLU) identified fewer, more reliable revisions, revealing a reliability-coverage trade-off. These findings establish longitudinal belief updating as a distinct dimension of LLM reliability.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型在患者证据演变时表现出临床判断更新不可靠。
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在临床推理中的应用日益广泛，但它们在患者证据变化时是否能够恰当修正判断仍不明确。我们通过评估电子健康记录中匹配的重症监护轨迹，对纵向信念更新进行了研究。在多种LLMs中，当估计值发生变化时，基于先前判断的条件化预测误差往往增加而非减少，这一结果在第二个终点也得到了验证。受控干预揭示了两种失效模式。首先，当先前评估固定时，模型对恶化的呼吸证据的反应比匹配的改善证据更强；这种不对称性在中等和强证据水平下校正后依然存在。其次，当当前证据固定时，将先验风险从10%提高到90%使估计值变化了26.2个百分点，证明了先验模型信念的因果影响。提示操作未能恢复可靠的更新。证据验证纵向更新（EVLU）识别出更少但更可靠的修正，揭示了可靠性与覆盖范围的权衡。这些发现将纵向信念更新确立为LLM可靠性的一个独立维度。

articles.title: Asterism: Exploring and Synthesizing Scattered Observations into Literature-Grounded Hypotheses and Theories
articles.abstract: A theory draws many independent observations into one framework with novel hypotheses. A researcher building such a theory must synthesize observations scattered across many papers, each describing related concepts but often in different terms. Which concepts matter most also depends on their preferences and research questions. Recent approaches scale theory synthesis with LLMs, but automate away choices and intuitions from researchers. We present Asterism, which extracts observations from hundreds of papers as concept-relation triples, with concepts unified in a hierarchical ontology. Researchers curate an evidence graph using the ontology and aggregate observations at different levels of granularity to focus theory formation on specific phenomena of interest. In a field deployment (n=10), researchers worked from observations to theories, and kept concepts and hypotheses fitting their preferences. In two case studies, teams of immunology and agriculture researchers discovered mechanisms outside their standard analyses and constructed hypotheses worth follow-up experiments.
articles.titleCn: 星群探索：将零散观测整合为基于文献的假设与理论
articles.abstractCn: 一个理论通过新颖的假设将许多独立的观察纳入一个框架中。构建此类理论的研究者必须综合分散在许多论文中的观察，每篇论文描述相关的概念，但通常使用不同的术语。哪些概念最重要也取决于研究者的偏好和研究问题。最近的方法使用大型语言模型来扩展理论综合，但自动化地排除了研究者的选择和直觉。我们提出了Asterism，它从数百篇论文中提取观察，并将其表示为概念-关系三元组，并在分层本体中统一概念。研究者使用本体构建证据图，并在不同粒度级别上聚合观察，以将理论形成集中于感兴趣的特定现象。在一个领域部署（n=10）中，研究者从观察开始构建理论，并保持符合其偏好的概念和假设。在两个案例研究中，免疫学和农业研究团队发现了超出其标准分析的机制，并构建了值得后续实验验证的假设。

articles.title: LEAP: Learning Efficient Action Proposals For LLM Agents
articles.abstract: LLM agents are known to be slow in rollouts. An agent completes a task one step at a time. At each step, it reasons and then chooses an action to execute. The next step and action cannot start until the previous one has finished. Speculative decoding accelerates the rollouts at the reason phase by drafting and verifying the inference tokens. Recent works have also started to apply similar ideas at the action phase. These works use off-the-shelf models, usually large, to draft action proposals for target model to verify. Large drafters match the target more often but take longer to propose, while small off-the-shelf models are fast but rarely make the same decision as the target. We ask a more general question: what determines the end-to-end speedup of action speculation? To answer it, we develop a latency framework for the speculative round. The framework compares what a round gains with what it costs. The gain depends on how well the drafter predicts the target and on how many steps the task can take before it ends. The cost comes from drafting, from waiting for target verification and from executing tools. Guided by the framework, we introduce LEAP (Learning Efficient Action Proposals) which keeps the drafter small and makes it accurate by training it on the target actions sequences. With a small 0.6B model, LEAP agrees with the target on most decisions and makes agents up to 60% faster in end-to-end wall clock time, with no systematic change in task success. Across various datasets, target models and draft models, the framework accounts for most of the measured speedups. We also show the draft model can be online trained with no prior trace collection and match the performance of offline training, making LEAP practical to deploy in the real world.
articles.titleCn: LEAP：为大型语言模型代理学习高效动作建议
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理在部署时通常较慢。代理一次完成一个任务步骤。在每个步骤中，它会进行推理，然后选择要执行的动作。下一个步骤和动作不能开始，直到前一个步骤完成。推测解码通过起草和验证推理标记来加速推理阶段的部署。最近的研究也开始在动作阶段应用类似的想法。这些研究使用现成的模型，通常是大型模型，为目标模型起草动作提案以供验证。大型起草者更频繁地匹配目标，但提出提案的时间更长，而小型现成模型速度快，但很少做出与目标相同的决策。我们提出了一个更普遍的问题：什么决定了动作推测的端到端加速？为了回答这个问题，我们为推测轮次开发了一个延迟框架。该框架比较一轮获得的收益与付出的成本。收益取决于起草者预测目标的准确性以及任务在结束前可以执行的步骤数量。成本来自起草、等待目标验证以及执行工具。在框架的指导下，我们引入了LEAP（学习高效动作提案），它保持起草者的小型化，并通过在目标动作序列上训练使其准确。使用一个0.6B的小模型，LEAP在大多数决策上与目标一致，并将代理的端到端墙钟时间提高了高达60%，而任务成功率没有系统性变化。在各种数据集、目标模型和起草模型中，该框架解释了大部分测量的加速效果。我们还展示了起草模型可以在没有先验跟踪收集的情况下进行在线训练，并匹配离线训练的性能，使LEAP在实际世界中部署成为可能。

articles.title: Large Language Continuous Diffusion Models
articles.abstract: Despite the success of discrete diffusion language models (dLMs) for fast parallel decoding, their non-smooth, high-dimensional space hinders trajectory steering for reasoning and inference acceleration. To overcome this, we present Sigma, the first large-scale (3B/8B) continuous dLM built on steerable, low-dimensional ODE/SDE latent trajectories. Trained blockwise via likelihood optimization, Sigma jointly denoises Gaussian-corrupted token embeddings while learning an optimal embedding geometry. To accelerate training, Sigma leverages pre-trained weights from autoregressive (AR) models for warm-starting. During inference, we identify classifier-free guidance and score temperature as essential for high-fidelity reasoning and coding. Across comprehensive math reasoning and coding evaluations against state-of-the-art discrete counterparts (masked dLMs and AR baselines), Sigma achieves competitive performance with discrete models on standard benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, Minerva, HumanEval, MBPP) after pre-training and on challenging reasoning tasks (e.g., MATH-500, AIME) after supervised fine-tuning. Beyond performance parity, we uncover key structural properties unique to continuous dLMs: (i) embedding-space steering effectively governs the quality-diversity trade-off, yielding strong pass@k performance and (ii) continuous trajectories enable graceful degradation for low NFEs and efficient distillation. These establish continuous dLMs as a promising paradigm for efficient language generation.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言连续扩散模型
articles.abstractCn: 尽管离散扩散语言模型（dLMs）在快速并行解码方面取得了成功，但其非平滑、高维空间阻碍了推理和推理加速的轨迹引导。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了Sigma，这是首个基于可引导、低维ODE/SDE潜在轨迹的大规模（3B/8B）连续dLM。通过似然优化分块训练，Sigma在联合去噪高斯污染的token嵌入的同时学习最优嵌入几何。为了加速训练，Sigma利用自回归（AR）模型的预训练权重进行热启动。在推理过程中，我们识别出无分类器引导和评分温度对于高保真推理和编码至关重要。在综合数学推理和编码评估中，与最先进的离散对应模型（掩码dLMs和AR基线）相比，经过预训练的Sigma在标准基准（如GSM8K、Minerva、HumanEval、MBPP）上实现了与离散模型具有竞争力的性能，经过监督微调的Sigma在挑战性推理任务（如MATH-500、AIME）上表现优异。除了性能相当之外，我们还揭示了连续dLM独有的关键结构特性：（i）嵌入空间引导有效控制了质量-多样性权衡，实现了强大的pass@k性能；（ii）连续轨迹支持低NFE的平滑退化以及高效的蒸馏。这些特性确立了连续dLM作为高效语言生成有前景的范式。

articles.title: VERSE: Verified Self-Evolving Optimizer for Agent Harnesses
articles.abstract: Harness evolution improves an LLM agent's prompts, tools, and workflow, while the optimizer's own tools and procedures often remain fixed. We study whether an optimizer can improve another agent more effectively by also improving how it diagnoses failures, develops edits, and tests their effects. Two observations guide our design. In a controlled study, optimizer self-evolution fails to improve performance without execution-based verification, but achieves the best result of that study when verification is available. Across five executors, self-evolving optimizers build their own tools for failure analysis, verification, training audits, and workflow control. Motivated by these findings, we introduce VERSE, a Verified Self-Evolving optimizer for agent harnesses. VERSE lets the optimizer test draft edits, replay failures, and perturb suspected steps before submission, while tracking fixes and regressions across rounds. Using this feedback, the optimizer revises both the executor harness and its own prompts, skills, tools, hooks, and notes, while the weights of the optimizer and executor models stay fixed. Under a shared protocol with disjoint training, validation, and test tasks, VERSE improves all four evaluated harness optimizers on held-out SWE-rebench tasks and newer out-of-distribution tasks in five languages. Its best validation-selected harness reaches 42.3% and 37.7% accuracy, respectively, against 39.2% and 29.3% for the strongest baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/wzekai/VERSE.
articles.titleCn: 适用于智能体框架的验证式自进化优化器
articles.abstractCn: 进化引擎通过改进大型语言模型代理的提示、工具和工作流程，而优化器自身的工具和流程通常保持固定。我们研究了优化器是否可以通过改进其故障诊断、编辑开发以及效果测试的方式，更有效地提升另一个代理的性能。两项观察结果指导了我们的设计。在受控研究中，优化器自我进化在没有基于执行的验证的情况下无法提升性能，但在验证可用时取得了该研究中的最佳结果。在五个执行器上，自我进化的优化器为其自身的故障分析、验证、训练审计和工作流程控制构建了工具。受这些发现的启发，我们引入了VERSE，一种用于代理引擎的验证自我进化优化器。VERSE允许优化器在提交前测试草拟的编辑、重放故障以及扰动可疑步骤，同时跟踪各轮次的修复和回归。利用这些反馈，优化器会修订执行器引擎以及自身的提示、技能、工具、钩子和注释，而优化器和执行器模型的权重保持固定。在一个共享协议下，该协议具有分离的训练、验证和测试任务，VERSE在五个语言的SWE-rebench任务和新的分布外任务上提升了所有四个评估的引擎优化器。其最佳验证选择的引擎达到了42.3%和37.7%的准确率，而最强的基线分别为39.2%和29.3%。代码可在https://github.com/wzekai/VERSE获取。

articles.title: Learning When to Commit from Partial Speech for End-to-End Simultaneous Speech Translation
articles.abstract: Simultaneous speech translation must emit useful target text before the source is complete while preserving every committed token. We adapt a full-utterance speech language model using prefix supervision derived from its own complete- and partial-waveform translations, requiring neither transcripts nor human translations. We compare single-turn forced-prefix and multi-turn append-only decoding, use a confidence threshold to control the inference-time quality--latency trade-off, and vary the density of training prefixes with a separate synthesis margin. On FLEURS and CoVoST2 in three language directions, prefix training improves quality--latency frontiers over the unadapted model, and confidence provides the broadest consistently competitive operating range. Multi-turn decoding is generally stronger at low latency; under multi-turn training, commit-calibration error falls by 63--68% overall and 68--80% at early prefixes, whereas single-turn training provides only modest overall calibration gains and no early-prefix improvement. A small synthesis margin sometimes extends the frontier to lower latency, particularly on shorter utterances, while a larger margin degrades translation quality and calibration. Prefix adaptation therefore improves simultaneous speech translation, especially under multi-turn append-only decoding, while synthesis density introduces a non-monotonic quality--latency trade-off.
articles.titleCn: 从部分语音中学习何时提交以实现端到端语音翻译
articles.abstractCn: 实时语音翻译必须在源语音未完成前输出有用目标文本，同时保留所有已确认的词汇。我们采用全句语音语言模型，利用其自身完整波形和部分波形翻译产生的前缀监督进行适配，无需转录文本或人工翻译。我们比较了单轮强制前缀解码和多轮追加解码，使用置信度阈值控制推理时的质量-延迟权衡，并通过独立的合成间隔调整训练前缀的密度。在FLEURS和CoVoST2三个语言方向上，前缀训练使未适配模型的质量-延迟前沿得到提升，置信度提供了最广泛的持续竞争力操作范围。多轮解码通常在低延迟时表现更优；在多轮训练下，确认校准误差整体下降63-68%，早期前缀下降68-80%，而单轮训练仅提供适度的整体校准增益，且无早期前缀改进。较小的合成间隔有时能将前沿扩展至更低延迟，尤其在较短的语音上，而较大的间隔会降低翻译质量和校准效果。因此，前缀适配提升了实时语音翻译性能，尤其在多轮追加解码下，而合成密度引入了非单调的质量-延迟权衡。
